## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: write the clock-agreement assumption down; the lease mechanism stays as it is

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #17 in which this card was item 4 with the recommendation A (fallback B). Verbatim reply: 「同意」 — adopts the recommendation.

**Ruled: A.** `CronJobAdapter.runScheduled`'s docblock (`packages/services/service-job/src/cron-job-adapter.ts`) and the multi-node section of `content/docs/deployment/` state the guarantee with its window: leader election de-duplicates *concurrent* fires — the mutual-exclusion window is the handler's runtime, not the scheduling deadline — so exactly-once per deadline holds only when replica clocks agree to within that window (NTP-synced deployments), and `once` has no later tick to self-correct. The `DbJobAdapter.schedule()` routing docblock gets the same sentence. Option B (hold the lease keyed to the deadline plus takeover semantics) is not built — zero measured pull, no measured skew-to-runtime ratio, and it is a distributed-design item, consistent with the 2026-09-01 ruling on #13918 (「⛔ 不建」). This is bookkeeping, not closure: if a real duplicate-fire incident is measured on a `once` schedule, B returns as its own card and is ruled together with #14501's `(flow, tick-window)` dispatch-claim ledger, which would defend against this skew as well.

Execution: `domain:services` lane, S, docs-only, `Clause-②: no`, `skip-changeset` if no published `.d.ts` prose moves (measure). ⛔ No mechanism change; if the dev finds the docblock sentence cannot be made true without one, stop and report.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #11.
